reason: Reviewed lifecycle hooks, the Notifai skill, harness setup, CLI readiness and domain terms. Three output fixes from a review of real sessions; the skill, topics and hooks are unchanged. The guidance gate keeps up to 8 reads per Agent Session, each with the folder it was read for, so a read in each folder keeps counting; a refusal names the folder the command ran in and the folder last read, with the exact cd-and-read command, after a coordinator reading guidance in its Project and sending from a projectless folder was refused for two hours. A send that prints anything after it went out now starts with `Sent <request id>.` and prints its advice after, after an agent took a naming nudge for a failure and sent twice. The Project naming nudge is shown only when the service holds no display name, and its command passes --project so it works from any folder. A guidance change note tells running sessions.
